note: Uncommitted experiment, measured and reverted. The synthetic log was copied into one buffer per partition at startup, and a fetch from offset 0 was sent as one slice instead of one slice per batch. Twelve interleaved pairs on one host, same runtime, parent and candidate null brokers. Before median 495,237.86 records/s, after median 482,231.47. Paired mean ratio 0.958, bootstrap 95% CI 0.914 to 0.997. Nine of twelve pairs were slower. Client CPU-nanoseconds per record median ratio was 1.038. Every run verified. The code was not kept. This is not a peer comparison and not a KL09-70 claim.
